Test Case 1: Git Configuration Validation

Input:
- Pod: devbob-0, devbob-1, devbob-2
- Command: git config --global --list | grep -E '(user\.name|user\.email|init\.defaultBranch|push\.autoSetupRemote)'

Expected Output:
- user.name=Devbob Agent (or similar)
- user.email=devbob@metabob.local (or similar)
- init.defaultBranch=main
- push.autoSetupRemote=true

Validation:
- Output must contain 'user.name=' and 'user.email='
- Both must have non-empty values
- Indicates git is properly configured for commit attribution
